author: System
title: Vanilla MLP Baseline
abstract: Simple vanilla MLP baseline for multi-dataset RNA sequence modeling. Uses distributed training across 3 RNA datasets (APA, Modif, PRS) with default hyperparameters for robust multi-task evaluation.

original_submission.content:
"""
Default baseline submission for Multi-Dataset RNA Sequence Modeling.
Uses all system defaults - no custom implementations.
"""

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Use exact same hyperparameters as default."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 512,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1
    }

# Uses system defaults for:
# - create_network: Adaptive MLP for sequence-level tasks
# - Hardcoded loss: MSE for regression and multilabel regression, BCE for multilabel classification
# - create_optimizer: AdamW optimizer
# - complete: No-op
